source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Sergeant at Arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. Let's pause for a minute of silent prayer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: In Jesus' name, Amen. The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Sen. Judge Cayetano Allan, Sen. Judge Cayetano Pia, Sen. Judge De La Rosa, Sen. Judge Ejercito, Sen. Judge Estrada, Sen. Judge Goque, Sen. Judge Hontiveros, Sen. Judge Lacson, Sen. Judge Lapid, Sen. Judge Legarda, Sen. Judge Marcoleta, Sen. Judge Marcos, Sen. Judge Padilla, Sen. Judge Pangilinan, Sen. Judge Soto III, Sen. Judge Tulfo Erwin. Senator-Judge, Tulfo Rafi, Senator-Judge, Villanueva, Senator-Judge, Villar Camil, Senator-Judge, Villar Marc, Senator-Judge, Zubiri, The Presiding Officer, Senator-Judge, Escudero, The Senate President, Senator-Judge, Cachalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 16 Senator-judges present, the Chair declares the presence of a quorum. In accordance with the Rules of Procedure on Impeachment Trials, the Chair now recognizes the newly elected Procedure Officer to preside over the proceedings of the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: I stand corrected. We have 17 Senator-Judges present.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President. If there are no objections, we shall dispense with the reading of the September 21, 2026 Journal of the Senate sitting as an Impeachment Court and consider the same as approved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will please call the case before the Impeachment Court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Case number 004-2026 in the matter of Impeachment Trial of Vice President Saira Zirman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Appearances for the parties.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honors. Same appearance for the prosecution. We are ready, Your Honor. I

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: presume, Honorable Luistro, that Attorney Erwin will still stand for this case.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: For the respondent?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. Same appearance for the respondent...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Good morning, Attorney Sheila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: ...accused, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Same, Attorney Justin will

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: also

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: stand for the respondent?

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: That's correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The witness will kindly be please escorted by the clerk of court through the auditorial witness stand. Attorney Del Rosario, please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” R. Luistro
turns.text: May we request Your Honor that Atty. Erwin Matib be recognized, Your Honor. Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: please, ma'am. Atty. Erwin is recognized as well as Atty. Justin for the respondent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Bago po tayo magsimula, magandang umaga, Atty. Del Rosario. Paumanhin po kahapon kung hindi ko kayo na-excuse bago po kami nag-asikaso ng mga administrative na mga bagay kahapon at bago po ako mag-adjourn. Hindi ko po makakalimutan gawin yan. Ngayon, pangako ko po sa inyo. Salamat po. Do you understand, Atty. Del Rosario, that you will continue to testify under and based on the same oath you took yesterday?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Salamat po, Atty. Del Rosario. Atty. Justin, are you ready for your cross?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, with the court's permission.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: When you're ready, you may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Turning to my cross.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sir Del Rosario, Atty. Del Rosario, magandang umaga po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Magandang umaga po sa inyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Good morning. Simulan po natin sir. During your direct examination yesterday, you identified records belonging to several corporations. In general, yung mga records na ito are those on file or are available with the records of the SEC or the Securities and Exchange Commission. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And now, the SEC compiled and produced these documents or these records upon the request of the House of Representatives. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Direquest po nila sa amin yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. And you confirmed that these corporate records were actually first requested po in relation to the hearings of the House of Representatives Committee on Justice. Naalala niyo po iyon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. And you confirmed that you also testified under oath during that committee hearings before the House of Representatives. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And can you please confirm, sir, whether this date was on April 22, 2026? Can you recall that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Ang matandaan ko po ay ang subpina, ang date po niya is April 14, pero hindi naman po agad kami natanong noon. Patuloy siya, hindi ko na po matandaan yung exactong pecha. Kung kailan po ako natanong during that impeachment proceeding sa Committee

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: of Justice. Okay lang po, Atty. Delosario. Now, tama po bang sabihin, sir, na yung Securities and Exchange Commission ay nag-compile and release ng corporate documents base po sa informasyon na binigay ng House of Representatives.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po kung ano po yung kanilang hiniling sa amin yung po ang ibinigay namin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In other words, yung House of Representatives po yung nagbigay ng informasyon at listahan ng mga kumpanya kung anong mga kumpanya ang iko-compile nyo yung mga records nila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, kahapon po nung direct examination ni Atty. Matib, you testified and answered, or just please correct me, that you stated na hindi naman po kayo personally aware sa mga contents ng SAL-N ng ating VC Presidente. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po. Wala po akong access sa SAL-N ng kahit sino po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Besides your own SAL-N, tama

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Yun lang pong SAL-N ko ang alam kong

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: nakikita ko.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Tama. And you confirm also, sir, and just for the record, pakikonfirm na lang po na yung Securities and Exchange Commission natin sa Pilipinas as an office would also have no information about the contents of any salens of other public officers including specifically the salen of the Vice President. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po. Hindi po sa amin ang lagakan

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: ng mga salen.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So yung tanong ko po, at the time when you first compiled and gathered all the documents, corporate records that are on file or maintained by the Securities and Exchange Commission, wala pong personal na knowledge yung SEC na yung mga korporasyon na iyon ay nakadeklara o nakalagay sa salay ng ating vicepresidente?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Hindi po

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: namin

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: alam.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In other words, is it correct to say that the SEC merely relied on the information provided by the House of Representatives?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Objection.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Just to clarify, Your Honor, is the Council is referring to the SEC, Your Honor. Perhaps he should refer to this witness, Your Honor, because SEC, we're talking about an institution, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: The documents come from the SEC, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It's a comment, Atty. Justin, anyway. Atty. Erwin, you may proceed, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Your Honor. Kayo po, kayo po mismo at ang opisina niyo, nag-rely lang po kayo sa impormasyon na pinigay ng House of Representatives.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you confirm that as the representative of the Securities and Exchange Commission, specifically the Company Registration and Monitoring Department, your testimony Before this court is limited to the records that are maintained by your division. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, kahapon din po, Atty. Del Rosario, nag-identify din po kayo for the first time ng mga summaries na supposedly and according to you, prepared by your office. Do you recall that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po. Naalala ko po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And according to you, these summaries were supposedly prepared by the Securities and Exchange Commission upon the request of the Prosecution Panel. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And specifically, this request from the Prosecution Panel of the House of Representatives is through a letter dated September 10, 2026. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At sino po yung pumirma nung letter request na yun galing sa House of Representatives?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Ang nakalagda po sa request na yun ay si Congresswoman Louise Stroh.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And in relation to that request that we are just discussing now, Atty., You confirmed that your office prepared two separate sets of summaries nung pinakita natin kahapon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Particularly, isa dito is yung may label na tinatawag na Summary of Vice President Duterte Shareholdings tapos sa ibang pages naman, Manassas R. Carpio Shareholdings. Naalala niyo po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Kayo po ba yung naglagay ng label na yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. My next question. Now, this summary contains several information relative to articles of incorporation and general information sheets of various corporations. Do you confirm that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And do you have that document with you now? I'll be going into those documents.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Dala ko po. Nasa holding room lang yung mga dokument.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sige. Your Honor, just to allow the witness to have that document since my cross will pertain to that, may we just request that the witness be allowed to secure those documents or if the prosecution... could help and provide the witness with that document.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Your Honor, if I may be clarified, yung summary po, dala ko ngayon, pero yung pinanggalingan po ng buod ng summary ko ay nasa holding room po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ah, okay. I'm referring to particularly po, Atty. Delosario, yung mga summary nasa inyo po. Sige po, please po, pakilabas na lang po kasi may mga tungako in relation to those documents.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You already have a copy of that, Atty. Justin, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, we confirm, but Nevertheless, Your Honor, we'd just like to put on record that we haven't been given the letter dated September 10, 2016.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: But it's okay, Your Honor. May I proceed, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Please proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Now, hawak nyo na po yung dalawang summary?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Hawak ko na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, puntahan po natin yung unang summary po. Yung may informasyon tungkol sa Articles of Incorporation at ng General Information Sheet ng iba't ibang mga kumpanya. Tawagin na lang po natin yung first summary. Tama po ba na 27 pages yan? Pakicheck po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Composed of 27 pages.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Tapos yung pangalawang summary naman po, yung isang summary rather, you confirm that ito yung containing yung title niya, Incorporators Declared in the AOI- by Company, and sa ibang pages naman, Shareholders Declared in the GIS. dash by shareholder. Inukumpirman niyo po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, you confirmed that the second summary or the summary that you are looking at now is composed of 26 pages. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Yung pangalawang summary po ay listahan ng mga incorporators.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Correct. And it is composed of 26 pages. Yan po yung tanong ko, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, you confirmed that itong dalawang mga summary na to po that came from your office and was supposedly prepared by your office are undated. or walang date. Tama po ba na nakalagay sa dokumento?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Opo. Walang date.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you confirm that both these summaries that your office supposedly prepared are also unsigned or walang perma po ng kahit sa sino man. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you confirm that both these summaries that are supposedly again prepared by your office does not have a seal or even the logo of the Securities and Exchange Commission or your division. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now let's go to the letter dated September 14, 2026 that you signed. Nasa inyo na po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Nasa akin na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you confirm that in this letter it states, and I quote, and please confirm this, and I quote, To prepare a summary of general information sheet and audited financial statements of the corporations and partnerships in your letter in connection with the impeachment trial of the Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte. You confirm na may paragraph na ganyan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Meron po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And the second paragraph of the same letter dated September 14, 2026 that you also signed, you confirm that it states, and I quote, the Commission respectfully transmits herewith the summaries of GIS and AFS both in electronic and hard copies format. End of quote. You confirm that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, based on that document po, Atty. Del Rosario, can you please confirm that there is no mention for a request Of a summary of the articles of incorporations. Wala pong nakamention dyan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Hindi po nakasulat.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Pasensya po, uminom lang. And you also confirm that there is also no summary, there's also no request rather, of summary of incorporators in that letter request.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Ayon po sa ang trasbital letter, wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you confirm, Atty. Del Rosario, that in the general information sheet naman po, Bilang isang kawaninang ating SEC, ang nare-reflect po sa GIS are the current stockholders of the corporation. At iniindicate lang whether yung current stockholders ay incorporator or hindi. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And it does not have a portion where the incorporators of a corporation are declared constantly unlike our articles of incorporation. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, despite the absence of a request for a summary of articles of incorporations or incorporators of businesses in the relevant letters, you confirm that in both your summaries, your office supposedly prepared and even included summaries of information relative to articles of incorporation, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: I have to object, Your Honor, because the question is misleading.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Why is it misleading, Attorney Aaron?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: It is misleading, Your Honor, because Council was referring to the September 14, 2026, transmit a letter. That was not the request letter. The request letter was September 10, 2026, which clearly stated the inclusion of articles of incorporation for the summary.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, we're asking in relation to September 14, 2026.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: If there is such a letter. If

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: there is such... Request with respect to those summaries.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: But Your Honor, that September 14 is the transmittal letter from the SEC.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Again, if there is such a request, the problem is that the transmittal letter has not yet been furnished with the counsel for the respondent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: That is precisely the point of

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: the defense, Your Honor. We were never furnished with this request.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I'll allow it.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Witness may please answer. Objection overruled.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Maraming salamat po. Atorney, balikan ko lang po. Particularly po sa September 14, 2026 na sinulat ng SEC at yung pinirmahan nyo, hindi naman po sinabi doon na nag-submit kayo ng summaries ng Articles of Incorporation based on the words and those stated in that document.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po, hindi nga po nakasulat sa aking transmittal letter about Articles of Incorporation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Delosario. Apologies for interrupting you. And you confirm wala ding nakasulat sa transmittal letter mo yung Incorporators, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Pero you confirm, nasa summaries na pre-repair niyo, nandun yung mga impormasyon relative to articles in corporation and in corporators, tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Yan po yung basic na impormasyon sa bawat korporasyon, kaya naisama ko na po siya rin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, I'll take that answer, Atty. Delosario. Now, according to you, after receiving this request from the House of Representatives, you instructed members of your team or your office to work on this request, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At yan yung sabi niyo, kinumpirma niyo kahapon. Now, it would be correct for me to assume na itong mga empleyado na ito is under your direct supervision po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And these are of course employees of the Securities and Exchange, CMRD. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Apo, ng Departamento po, CRMD.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ah, CRMD. Maraming salamat po sa pag-correct sa akin, Sir. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And ilang membro po yung nagtrabaho dito, kung naalala niyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Limang tao po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And for the records, can you please name all these five people who helped you work on this?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: At isa pa pong empleyado rin namin na tumulong sa kanya ay si Ms. Pamela Munzon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, let's go to the first summary that you prepared, Atty. Del Rosario. I notice, sir, that the order of the corporation listed in at least the first four corporations is as follows. Can you please check? The first corporation mentioned is City Hall King Chow Foods Corporation, found on pages 1 and 2, with page 2 being at the back portion of the first leaf.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yung pangalawa naman, Metro City Chow Foods Corporation, found on pages 3 and 4, with page 4 being on the back leaf.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Third is GenCorp Industries, Inc., found on page 5, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And fourth is Kale88 Foods Corporation, found on page 6, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Na kung naalala nyo, ilang korporasyon yung pinaproduce ng House of Representatives sa opisina nyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Around 16 corporations po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: for such internal control, as punishment determined is necessary to enable the preparation of financial statement that are free from material statement whether due to fraud or error.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: The board of directors is responsible for overseeing the company's financial reporting process.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib

turns.text: Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So, sworn statement din po ito kung ganun?

turns.text: yun po ang nakalagay.

turns.text: Ano po ulit? Ang accountability ay?

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: So sila po ang accountable?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Ngayon, puntahan natin yung notes dyan sa financial statements na iyan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Page 13, nandun po ba kayo? Note 1, corporate information?

turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Ayon po sa second paragraph nito, the accompanying financial statements of the company as at and for the day, years 2024 and 2023 were approved and authorized by its Board of Directors on March 31, 2025.

turns.text: Ano po

turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Tama po. Securities po yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So, ayon sa Article 7, Section 13, bawal sa isang government official tulad ng VP o presidente na magkaroon ng participation in any company. Ayon po sa nakasaad sa ating Constitution. That's violation of the Constitution, right? Opo. Thank you. That's all.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kapag naman po may isang public official na siya mismo ang nagdeklara sa kanyang salin na meron siyang interest sa isang kumpanya, Pero yung pangalan niya ay hindi po nag-a-appear doon sa GIS bilang stockholder.

turns.text: Hindi ba yun precisely isang bagay yun na dapat tignan o i-review, mag-take action ng SEC?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Unang-una po ma'am, wala po kaming access on the SAL-N. Therefore, hindi po namin alam kung yung mga kumpanyang in

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: -list niya roon ay talagang kabilang siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So, paano po ba tinatrato itong ganitong sitwasyon ng inyong ahensya na wala yung pangalan ng isang opisyal bilang stockholder sa GIS pero na pag-aalaman ninyo na siya mismo inilagay yung pangalan niya sa SAL-N?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Wala po kami magiging action dyan. Gawa po ng base sa record namin, hindi naman po talaga siya stockholder. Siguro po, ibang ahensya po siguro dapat mag-investiga on that. Dahil ang mandato lang po namin ay improve ang capital market. In fact, ang mahalaga nga po sa amin ay yung corporate formations na kaya hinihikayat nga po namin sila na magtayo ng kumpanya sa Pilipinas.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Aling ibang ahensya ang dapat mag-imbestiga kung may ganitong sitwasyon na official mismo magsabi sa SAL-N niya kahit wala siya doon sa GIS?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Una po ang SAL-N ay sinusumiti po, ang alam ko, sa Ombudsman. Kaya para nga sa akin po, yung provision sa Constitution, sila rin po sigurang tumingin. Dahil yung provision na po ito, alam ko, hindi naman dapat ipatupad ng ahensya kundi sarili niya mismo alam niya dapat. kung ano yung restriction sa kanya. Ayon sa pagkakaunawa niya sa definisyon dun sa Section 7, Article 7, Section 13.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kung inilagay sa SAL-N kahit wala siya sa GIS, maituturing ba yan na admission against interest?

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Admission against interest. Sa akin po, interest nga po yun eh.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And ano naman po yung ginagawa ng SEC para makita Kung may indirect ownership, beneficial ownership, nominee arrangement, intermediary o iba pang layer ng corporate ownership sa mga kumpanya na isinusumite sa inyo sa mga dokumento.

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: Iyon nga pong beneficial ownership form. Yun po ang magsisilbing reporting sa amin upang malaman kung sino talaga yung ultimate ownership which should be na dapat ay natural person.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Atty. Gerardo F. del Rosario
turns.text: maiwasan din po yung mga corporate layering at maipakita rin sino ba talaga ang may control nung nasabing shares of stock.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So dun lamang po sa beneficial ownership form, yun lamang po yung magagawa ninyo para makita kung sino talaga ang nagmamayari at sino talagang nakikinabang sa mga nakadeklara sa mga dokumentong sinusumite sa inyo. Tama po ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay.

turns.text: So

turns.text: baka huli po Atty. Del Rosario, ano po yung effect ng isang undeclared beneficial ownership sa pananaw po ng SEC?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Bukod sa undeclared beneficial ownership, ano pa po yung nire-review ninyong enforcement department ng SEC?

turns.text: Thank you. With the indulgence of Senator-Judge JV, who is availing of his first round, I believe Senator-Judge Raffi has only one question.

turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Kahapon po, bilang sagot sa tanong ko, Atty. Gular responded that my question called for an answer. to a hypothetical question. Tama naman kung datusin. turns.text: Yung pong sagot ko on that ay kung meron kaming guidelines to report. Yun po yung wala kaming guidelines. Pero kung sa yung tanong niyo po ngayon kung dapat po siyang may divest, malinaw mo naman po sa batas na meron prohibition. Na dapat sana, alam niya, bilang mataas na ka-opisyal ng gobyerno, na pinanumpaan niya nun siya ay nag-swear to act as president, vice president, na iyon ang Iyon ang kanyang limitasyon. Kaya dapat sana bago siya nanumpa, tinanggal na niya o nag-divest na po siya. Na nakita naman po natin meron ditong GES na kung saan na hindi naging party na si Bibi Sara sa ilang kumpanya nung dumating yung at least 2019 pa po nga ay hindi na rin nag-appear yung kanyang pangalan. Siguro yun po yung divestment.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Maraming salamat po sa inyong kasagutan. So, binigit po ninyo that the SEC does not proactively flag these cases. Sino pong ordinarily ang dapat makapansin at mag-correct nito kung kailangan ng koreksyon? Tama po ba na ang documents are ordinarily prepared by the Corporate Secretary?

Let's say, tinanggal siya, bakit ako tinanggal? That's issue of corporate controversy which we refer the matter to the regular court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo

turns.text: At bilang panghuli Mr. Witness sa puntong ito, bilang division chief, pakipaliwanag po sa kagalanggalang na impeachment court, paano ho ba ang actual operation ng PhilGips as a system?

turns.speaker: Rendell P. Sopeña
turns.text: As a system po, Ang unang kailangan pong gawin ng mga procuring entities or mga government agencies is to register po sa field job system. Upon registering, the procuring entity can create po yung mga procurement activity nila to post sa system. Yung first step na kailangan po nilang gawin is to create a bid notice. So yung bid notice po is The publication of the procurement activity. So parang similar siya with mga pinupost po sa dyaryo ng mga nasa classified ads na mas madaling makita ng publiko. Ang bid notice po is an electronic form of posting ng procurement activity kung saan po is i-encode po ng procuring entity yung mga activity ng details and mag-a-attach po ng mga attachment. And upon creation of the bid notice, This will be viewable by all public and mostly mga merchants na interesado pong sumali sa mga procurement activities ng gobyerno.

turns.speaker: Rendell P. Sopeña
turns.text: If

turns.speaker: Rendell P. Sopeña
turns.text: a merchant is willing po sila to join the activity, they should also be registered sa system natin. They would have an access po para ma-download yung mga documents attached sa bid notice pinost ng procuring entity. And upon submission po ng mga merchants, mga interested merchants sa procurement po, magsasubmit po sila ng mga kaukulang dokumento patungkol po dun sa activity na ito. And once the procurement activity is fully conducted by the procuring entity, Ang lahat po ng mga documents, related documents, such as yung mga back resolution, notice of award, yung mga technical documents po na nabanggit kanina. To close the created bid, mag-create po uli ang government agencies which is the main to create and to close po yung bid notice. So upon creation po ng award notice naman, lahat po ng mga dokumento. It pertains to the conducted procurement activity ay kailangan po nilang i-upload sa system para po ma-fully closed yung ginawa nilang bid notice. So, to highlight ang responsibility po ng pag-upload and ang pag-encode po ng mga tamang information sa system is

turns.speaker: Rendell P. Sopeña
